_note: Profiles and their on-board slots are read from Synapse (synapse_profiles.json). Each profile gets the Chroma effect with the most words in common (e.g. 'CS2' <-> 'Chroma Effect CS2'); effect_overrides forces a match when the names differ, e.g. {"Profile name": "Chroma Effect X"}. skip_slots: slots to skip (1 = Hybrid Storage, white indicator).

device._note: USB product id of the mouse (Basilisk V3 35K wired = 0x00CB). The LED count and the Chroma Studio grid are read from Synapse's logs (synapse_device.json); set leds and chroma_grid ({"row,col": LED index}) here only to override them.
device.name: Razer Basilisk V3 35K
